description: Simplify any ratio to its lowest terms. Enter two or three numbers and get the reduced ratio, the greatest common divisor and each part's share of the whole.

faqs.a: Every number in the ratio is divided by the greatest common divisor (GCD) of all the numbers. For example, 12:18:30 has a GCD of 6, so it simplifies to 2:3:5.

faqs.q: Can I simplify ratios with decimals?
faqs.a: Yes. Decimal inputs are scaled up to whole numbers first (for example 1.5:2.5 becomes 15:25) and then reduced, giving 3:5.

faqs.q: What does each part's percentage mean?
faqs.a: It is the simplified part divided by the total of the simplified parts. In 2:3:5 the first part is 2/10 = 20% of the whole.

howto: Enter the first and second numbers of your ratio.
Optionally add a third number for a three-part ratio.
The simplified ratio appears instantly, reduced by the greatest common divisor.
Use the table to see each part's simplified value and its percentage of the whole.
title: Ratio Simplifier
